Get ready to dance all night with Bollywood vibes and sky-high energy at the ultimate after-dark bash!

About this Event

🔥 BOLLYWOOD WAVE SKYCLUB Party at Vice Park 🔥Get ready, Dallas! Join us on NOV 20, 2026 at 10:00 PM (Central Time) for the ultimate nightlife takeover at Vice Park, 2601 Gaston Ave.
Experience a high-energy fusion of Bollywood × Punjabi × Techno × House beats that will keep you dancing all night long. Featuring the hottest tracks including Bollywood Hits & Remixes, Punjabi Bangers, BollyTech & EDM Drops, plus House & Techno Vibes.
RZONE and ASIM will be spinning nonstop, delivering insane drops and a packed dancefloor you don’t want to miss.
Expect premium rooftop vibes, an elite stylish crowd, stunning lighting & visuals, and exclusive VIP table experiences with bottle service.
21+ only, dress to impress (upscale/trendy recommended). Valid ID required.
Secure your spot now for Dallas’s biggest Electro Desi Night — one night, one vibe, one unforgettable SKYCLUB experience.
